title: Personalisation or Prejudice? Addressing Geographic Bias in Hate Speech Detection using Debias Tuning in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting large language models with country-specific personas (e.g., "Adopt the identity of someone from [Country]") and comparing their hate speech classification performance (F1 scores and False Negative Rates) across different countries against a baseline without geographic context.
Translating the original English hate speech dataset posts into the official languages of the assigned country personas and measuring the change in the models' classification performance.
